summary: Target ep 12 promoted to a full exact record: it adapts chs 20-21 (vol 5) nearly one-for-one - the SAT's kill-loop suppression of Sato (ch 20 'Sucker Punch'), then Gen/Takahashi's sniping, Tanaka's IBM counter-sniping, Sato's revival, the massacre and his exhausted walk-off plus Okuyama's drone downing the helicopter (ch 21 'Battlefield Bad Company') - with the episode title 'Whew, I'm beat' being Sato's line that closes ch 21. The closer (villager Kita recognizing Kei from the news reward) is a graft of ch 22's opening beat, played out differently (manga Kita hunts Kei himself with a shotgun; anime Kita phones it in), and a mid-episode village cutaway pulls Kita's bankruptcy motivation forward from later in the manga; the mid-arc Ko Nakano scenes (captivity, mini-TV) are anime-original, not adapted 22-24 material. The dedicated allyouranime comparison series (archived) independently states ep 11 = chs 19-20, ep 12 = chs 20-21, ep 13 = chs 22-22.5, which both confirms ep 12 and shows the stored ep 13 anchor's '13-21 compressed' framing (start 13) is stale - chs 13-19 live in eps 7-11, and ep 13 animates ch 22/22.5 material (heavily altered) plus ch 23's opening second-wave broadcast. The batch-12 S2-typed continue point (ep 13 continue→22) is verified consistent: ep 12 grafts only ch 22's first beat and ep 13's ch-22 events diverge so heavily that the honest resume is still ch 22.

anchors.note: allyouranime comparison: 'Episode 12/Chapters 20-21', 'majority of content is lifted from the manga, mostly one for one'; 'the manga ends Chapter 20 here' mid-episode (SAT stretcher/suppression success) and ch 21 runs to Tosaki's 'That didn't work'. Ep title = Sato's exhausted line closing ch 21 (fandom ch 21: 'commenting on how exhausted he was'). Ch 20 straddles eps 11/12 but its bulk (Tosaki's plan Q&A, SAT assault, suppression) is in ep 12, so START = 20. Kita's recognition of Kei that ends the episode 'is in the next chapter of the manga [22], although plays out differently'. Vol 5 = chs 20-24 per fandom Chapters and Volumes.

continue_points.note: ch 21 completed in full; the ch-22 content in ep 12 is only the opening recognition beat (and it plays out differently in the manga), so the reader resumes at 22

annotation_updates.note: narrowed from '22-24 + later-manga material': ep 12's only manga graft is ch 22's opening beat (Kita recognizing Kei via the news; Kita's bankruptcy motivation also pulled forward from its later manga reveal). The village-arc 22-24 compression belongs to ep 13; the early Ko Nakano scenes in eps 10-12 (captivity, mini-TV) are anime-original, not adapted chapters - manga Nakano is still a stranger watching the news in ch 20 and only joins Kei around chs 22.5-23

repairs.why: Ep 13 animates no chs 13-21 content: allyouranime's per-episode series places chs 13-19 in eps 7-11 (part 11 header 'Episode 11/Chapters 19-20') and chs 20-21 in ep 12, and its part 13 header is 'Episode 13/Chapters 22-22.5'. Ep 13 opens with Kita reporting Kei (ch 22 material, altered) and runs the escape (22/22.5, heavily altered: police manhunt replaces manga Kita's shotgun chase; Tosaki/Shimomura play no role in the manga version) plus ch 23's opening beat (Sato's second/third-wave broadcast; anime 15 targets vs manga 11). Stored end_chapter 21 and continue→22 are batch-12 ruled values and are left untouched - see flags.

repairs.old: ≈13-21 compressed + village beats (22-24) + Kō Nakano grafted early
repairs.why: Same evidence as the start_chapter repair: with eps 7-12 now carrying their own records through ch 21, the '13-21 compressed' framing is stale, and ch 24 (Kei-Tosaki alliance at the hospital) is nowhere in ep 13 - S1 ends before it and S2 goes anime-original instead. The 22-24 zone annotation on ep 13 can stand as arc-level context, but the anchor's adapted list should name what the episode actually animates.

flags_for_sean: Ep 13 END chapter judgment call, left for you: stored end_chapter=21 (batch-12, with the S2-typed continue→22) now duplicates ep 12's END 21. That is legal and defensible ('mainline faithfully complete through 21, resume at 22' - ep 13's chs 22/22.5 events are so altered that they are arguably divergence, not adaptation), but the honest-values alternative is end=22 with continue→22 (re-read: anime version diverges), since allyouranime maps ep 13 to chs 22-22.5. I repaired only start_chapter and chapters_adapted, which are factually wrong under either reading; the continue point 22 is verified consistent under both.

Independent-source landscape: ajin.fandom episode pages carry NO manga-counterpart fields and chapter pages no reverse episode fields - the load-bearing independent source is the allyouranime.net 13-part comparison series (site dead since ~2021; used via Wayback snapshots). The pleasesavetanaka tumblr breakdown covers only eps 1-6 (and matches stored ep 1/3/5/6 anchors exactly, good lineage confirmation); MAL ep 12 discussion (https://myanimelist.net/forum/?topicid=1496997) has no chapter posts.
